items.html: And it is found that the four lower joints of the NH of Arich clothe in ZA and become a soul for him, as above. However, his food is drawn from a higher place, which is from those two upper joints mentioned. And through this, the milk has the power of nourishment, to nourish, sustain, and grow the fetus, for he is nourished from the choicest of his soul and from the upper aspect.
